status: pre-registered before the test run; design data = the dev set below (MOTION-342 test scenes routed by B)

baseline.note: same baseline as MOTION-323/327/342; conclusions not extrapolated to upstream 0942d18

method.base: MOTION-342 B: MOTION-327 v2 frozen options (846f0dc) + fallback_joint_rrt + route_branch_change, TOPP-RA timing

option.wrist_flip: a stage routed by B whose nearest goal differs from the start only in the wrist branch (q2, q4 equal, q6 opposite) first tries a straight tool path with one controlled wrist flip: the box stops at a point X* with q6 = 0, q5 and q7 counter-rotate (self-motion), and the arm continues on the flipped branch; timed in three rest-to-rest TOPP-RA pieces (or one piece if shorter and valid). X* comes from Gauss-Newton steps from 16 points of the straight line in (progress, swivel, lift) onto the q6 = 0 curve, tried in the order of an estimated execution time (at most 3 per goal, up to 3 flipped-branch goals); a position offset of X* (<= 5 cm) only after every goal failed on the exact line. The search is capped at wrist_flip_budget_s = 0.6 s, otherwise the joint RRT gets the rest of the 2 s stage budget

method.design_evidence: motion312-acceptance/wristflip-20261024 (feasibility scan) and motion312-acceptance/m363-20261027: dev (first prototype, all arms), dev-v2..dev-v5 (X* search variants, wrist-flip arm only); dev-v5 is the frozen design

dev_set.purpose: design data: the MOTION-342 test scenes that B routed to the joint RRT

dev_check.data: motion312-acceptance/m363-20261027/dev-v5 against the MOTION-342 test runs of the same scenes and seeds
dev_check.result: success 42/42; 30 wrist flips, 12 joint RRT (left23/right21, elbow swing ~170 deg); wrist-flip search median 39 ms, max 611 ms; branch-change stages: paired median duration +32.4% against the reference (above the +30% rule), +10% to +61% per scene, larger with a wrist swing near 30 deg; projected on the MOTION-342 test: stage paired median +3.3%, duration +7.8%
dev_check.note: the duration threshold was set with the draft before any dev run and is kept unchanged

test_set.purpose: independent: new docking offsets and new seeds, never run before
test_set.scene_model: as MOTION-327/342: container walls, ground, filler blocks and target boxes shifted by (dx, dy, 0) relative to the robot; conveyor unchanged
test_set.generator: numpy.random.default_rng(363).uniform(-0.05, 0.05, size=(25, 2, 2)), rounded to 0.1 mm; tasks = the 25 single-arm tasks of MOTION-327 in the MOTION-342 order (the MOTION-342 generator reproduces its instances exactly)

decision_rules.against_baseline: MOTION-342 rules for the primary arm: paired median transport stage change <= +10% and every search within 2 s; success rate not lower than the baseline; paired median side extra rotation reduced by at least 30% and path/chord not increased; paired median execution duration increase <= 20%
decision_rules.against_reference: in stages that the reference routes to the joint RRT (branch-change stages): success not lower than the reference; every wrist flip that the primary arm makes in its wrist-flip tier is made at rest (tool speeds <= 5 mm/s and <= 2 deg/s at the q6 sign change); paired median execution duration of those stages <= +30% against the reference
decision_rules.recommendation: the primary arm is recommended over the reference if both rule sets pass; otherwise the reference stays the recommended form

report_only: branch-change stages: tier counts (wrist_flip / joint_rrt_routed), wrist-flip search time, flips at rest vs moving, side extra rotation, duration ratio to the reference and to the baseline
outside branch-change stages: share of transports frame-identical to the reference (same seed; time-budgeted searches may differ)
mesh audit (FCL meshes, true depth as in MOTION-326) of the executed transport frames

hypotheses.cartesian_v22_toppra: baseline rules as B; in branch-change stages most wrist-only changes take the wrist flip with zero extra rotation and no flip while moving; scenes that need an elbow swing of about 170 deg (MOTION-342 left23/right21) fall back to the joint RRT
